versions.content: Assigning communication graphs to particular RTE Imple- mentation Plug-Ins Type: valid Description: The System Template shall support to assign communication graphs of software components to particular RTE Implementation Plug-Ins. Rationale: The RTE of an ECU is build modularized with RTE Implementation Plug-Ins. Each communication graph is handled by a specific RTE Implementation Plug-In. Dependencies:  Use Case:  Supporting Material: 
